description: Phase 5 server layer: pure security core (keys, AES-256-GCM secret box, Argon2id, otplib TOTP, atomic lockout, insert-then-count IP rate limit), Zod schemas, sanitized Markdown, Auth.js v5 Credentials two-step login, server-side guards, runAdminAction wrapper with in-transaction AuditLog, all domain services (posts, categories, verses, events, media, settings, users with max-3 editors under advisory lock, inbox, audit, dashboard), all 'use server' actions, owner bootstrap CLI and E2E user preparation, with unit/DB/static tests. Implements plan.md items 5-8. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema, db.ts, prisma-factory, vitest db project, e2e-prepare). No admin UI pages here (FEAT-003).
steps: Plan item 5: src/server/auth/{keys,secret-box,password,totp,lockout,rate-limit}.ts, src/lib/{log,env,markdown}.ts, src/components/ui/MarkdownContent.tsx, src/lib/validation/{common,posts,categories,verses,events,media,settings,users,account,inbox,auth,list-query}.ts per design §7.4-7.6, §9, §10. common.ts MUST export emailSchema = z.string().trim().toLowerCase().pipe(z.email().max(254)) used by loginStep1Schema, createEditorSchema and the CLI (review NIT 1). Pure modules must not import server-only (§6.1a). Unit tests: validation/*.test.ts, markdown.test.ts (incl. rel='opener' overwritten to exactly 'noopener noreferrer nofollow'), secret-box/totp/password tests with // @vitest-environment node.

Plan item 6: src/auth.ts (§7.2), src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts, src/types/next-auth.d.ts, src/server/auth/login.ts (beginLogin/completeLogin, injectable clock, atomic conditional writes §7.6, InvalidLoginError extends CredentialsSignin), src/server/auth/guards.ts (§7.7), src/server/actions/auth.ts (start/complete/cancel/logout, signIn error mapping with unstable_rethrow, safeNext), src/server/actions/markdown.ts (previewMarkdownAction), src/lib/safe-next.ts + test. Comment in rate-limit.ts about trusting Vercel's x-forwarded-for (review NIT 4). Extend src/test/factories.ts with makeOwner/makeEditor (create with totpSecretEnc null, then update with seal(secret, `totp:${id}`) — review NIT 2) and setTestSession. Tests: src/server/auth/guards.test.ts, src/server/auth/login.db.test.ts covering AC16-AC20 incl. the parallel cases with the verifyPassword spy.

Plan item 7: src/server/actions/run-admin-action.ts (server-only, NOT 'use server'; §8 order and error mapping; formDataToObject); src/server/services/{posts,categories,verses,events,media,settings,users,inbox,audit,dashboard}.ts per §11 (no redirect in services; users.ts pg_advisory_xact_lock(42001) + max 3 active editors; posts.ts publishedAt rule: empty on update keeps stored value, publish sets now only if stored null, unpublish never touches it — review NIT 7); 'use server' action files src/server/actions/{posts,categories,verses,events,media,settings,users,inbox,account}.ts (create/delete redirect only after an ok result; changePasswordAction two-phase per §11). Static tests: src/server/actions/guard-coverage.test.ts, src/server/services/privacy-scan.test.ts, src/test/script-imports.test.ts (also asserts no file under src/ reads process.env.E2E). DB tests: src/server/actions/actions.db.test.ts, src/server/actions/account.db.test.ts, src/server/services/users.db.test.ts, src/server/services/inbox.db.test.ts, plus the posts publishedAt case.

Plan item 8: scripts/create-owner.ts per §14 (imports only pure modules; advisory lock 42002; create-then-update seal; --reset; audit owner.create/owner.reset with actorEmail 'cli'; never print the password). Extend scripts/e2e-prepare.ts with owner/editor/editor2 creation and playwright/.auth/e2e-users.json (§3.5 steps 5-6). Exercise the CLI non-interactively against mission_dev, then `npm run db:reset` to restore pristine demo data.
Run `npm run format`, then all verification commands; append evidence for items 5-8 to verification.md (redact any printed TOTP secret).
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest --run --project unit passes incl. validation, markdown, secret-box, totp, password, guards, safe-next, guard-coverage, privacy-scan, script-imports tests

npx vitest --run --project db passes incl. login.db.test.ts: identical message for unknown/wrong/inactive/locked; lock at 5; 10 parallel wrong passwords -> <=5 real-hash verifies, one auth.lockout row; 30 parallel IP attempts -> <=20 hash checks; 2 parallel completions -> exactly 1 success; TOTP replay rejected; corrupted secret -> GENERIC_MSG

actions.db.test.ts: EDITOR calling updateSiteSettingsAction/createEditorAction gets FORBIDDEN with DB unchanged and no audit row; no session -> UNAUTHENTICATED; each successful post mutation writes exactly one AuditLog row and calls revalidatePath('/[locale]', 'layout'); P2002 slug and P2003 category map to field errors
users.db.test.ts: 4th active editor fails with 'You can have at most 3 active editors.'; 3 concurrent creates with 2 existing -> exactly 1 success; reactivation at limit fails
npm run admin:create-owner with OWNER_PASSWORD exits 0, second run exits 1 'An owner already exists', --reset exits 0
npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run build exit 0
verification: $env:OWNER_PASSWORD='<random>'; npm run admin:create-owner -- --email owner@example.org --name "Local Owner"; Remove-Item Env:OWNER_PASSWORD
findings:
RESULTS: unit 25 files/249 tests, db 9 files/75 tests, npm test 34 files/324 tests; lint, typecheck, build (ƒ /api/auth/[...nextauth]; /en,/ne SSG), format:check all exit 0. Spy results: AC18 real-hash verifies 5 of 10 parallel; AC19 0 hash checks/30 rate-limited of 30 parallel (insert-then-count is conservative under a burst); AC20 1 fulfilled + 1 challenge_expired; AC21 concurrent creates 1 ok/2 LIMIT. CLI: create exit 0, second run exit 1 'An owner already exists (...)', --reset exit 0; audit owner.create/owner.reset actorEmail 'cli'. mission_dev reset to pristine demo data afterwards. Playwright NOT run (no admin UI yet).

ACTION RESULT SHAPE (src/server/actions/run-admin-action.ts, import type only from client code): ActionResult<T=undefined> = { ok: true; message: string; data?: T } | { ok: false; code: 'VALIDATION'|'UNAUTHENTICATED'|'FORBIDDEN'|'CONFLICT'|'NOT_FOUND'|'LIMIT'|'ERROR'; formError?: string; fieldErrors?: Record<string,string> } (fieldErrors keys = form field names, e.g. 'titleEn', 'social.facebook', 'categoryIds'). Also exports AUTHZ_MESSAGES, VALIDATION_MSG, NOT_FOUND_MSG, ERROR_MSG, formDataToObject(formData, {arrays}), checkbox, runAdminAction. On code UNAUTHENTICATED the client should navigate to /admin/login.

ACTIONS (all 'use server', signature (prev: ActionResult|null, formData: FormData) => Promise<ActionResult> unless noted; create actions return ActionResult<{id:string}>):
- posts.ts: createPostAction (redirects /admin/posts/<id>?toast=created), updatePostAction (needs id), setPostStatusAction (id,status=DRAFT|PUBLISHED), deletePostAction (id; redirects /admin/posts?toast=deleted). Post fields: type,titleEn,titleNe,slug,excerptEn,excerptNe,bodyEn,bodyNe,scriptureRefs (textarea, newline/comma separated),categoryIds (multiple values),coverImageUrl,isFeatured (checkbox),seoTitleEn/Ne,seoDescriptionEn/Ne,publishedAt (ISO with offset or ''),intent=draft|publish.
- categories.ts: createCategoryAction (NO redirect: inline create on list), updateCategoryAction, deleteCategoryAction (redirects /admin/categories?toast=deleted). Fields nameEn,nameNe,slug.
- verses.ts: createVerseAction (redirect /admin/verses/<id>?toast=created), updateVerseAction, setVerseStatusAction, setFeaturedVerseAction (id, date=YYYY-MM-DD), clearFeaturedVerseAction (id), deleteVerseAction (redirect /admin/verses?toast=deleted). Fields reference,text,translation=WEB|KJV,featuredOn (YYYY-MM-DD or ''),intent. Featuring a DRAFT -> VALIDATION 'Publish this verse before featuring it.'
- events.ts: createEventAction (redirect /admin/events/<id>?toast=created), updateEventAction, setEventStatusAction (id,status=ContentStatus -> publishStatus), deleteEventAction (redirect /admin/events?toast=deleted). Fields kind,slug,titleEn/Ne,descriptionEn/Ne,reportEn/Ne,startsAt (required ISO),endsAt,locationEn/Ne,volunteerInfoEn/Ne,status=UPCOMING|COMPLETED|CANCELLED,coverImageUrl,intent.
- media.ts: createMediaAction (redirect /admin/media/<id>?toast=created), updateMediaAction, setMediaStatusAction, deleteMediaAction (redirect /admin/media?toast=deleted). Fields type=IMAGE(url+altTextEn req, altTextNe)|AUDIO(url)|VIDEO_EMBED(embedUrl youtube), category, titleEn/Ne, descriptionEn/Ne, durationMinutes, thumbnailUrl, publishedAt, isFeatured, intent.
- settings.ts: updateSiteSettingsAction (OWNER). Fields per section 9 + one input per platform named social.facebook ... social.website (see socialFieldName in src/lib/validation/settings.ts) + checkboxes donationsEnabled, taxDeductibleVerified, isDemo.
- users.ts (OWNER): createEditorAction (name,email,password,confirmPassword), setUserActiveAction (id, active='true'|'false'), resetEditorTotpAction (id), setEditorPasswordAction (id,password,confirmPassword).
- inbox.ts: setPrayerStatusAction (id,status=NEW|PRAYED|ARCHIVED), setMessageStatusAction (id,status=NEW|READ|ARCHIVED).
- account.ts: changePasswordAction (currentPassword,newPassword,confirmPassword); on ok calls signOut({redirectTo:'/admin/login?changed=1'}).
- auth.ts: startLoginAction(prev: LoginState|null, fd: email,password,next) / completeLoginAction(prev, fd: code, step='verify'|'enroll', next) -> LoginState (type exported from src/server/auth/login.ts: { ok, step:'credentials'|'verify'|'enroll', formError?, fieldErrors?, next?, enrollment?: { otpauthUri, secret, qrSvg } }); completeLoginAction redirects to safeNext(next) ?? '/admin' on success. On invalid code it returns step only (no enrollment): the enroll form must keep the enrollment data from the previous state. cancelLoginAction(): Promise<LoginState> (no args). logoutAction(): Promise<void> (form action).
- markdown.ts: previewMarkdownAction(md: string) -> PreviewResult { ok:true, html } | { ok:false, code, formError } (type exported from the same file).

SERVICES / READ FUNCTIONS (server-only; pages call after their guard): Page<T> = { items, total, page, pageSize, pageCount } from src/server/services/shared.ts. posts: listPosts({q,page,type,status}), getPost(id) -> row + categoryIds | null. categories: listCategories({q,page}) (items include _count.posts), listAllCategories(), getCategory(id). verses: listVerses({q,page,status}), getVerse(id), utcDay(now?), getVerseFeaturedOn(day?). events: listEvents({q,page,kind,status}), getEvent(id). media: listMedia({q,page,type,status,category}), getMedia(id). settings: getSettingsForEdit(), socialUrlsOf(row) -> { [platform]: url }. users: listAdmins(), countActiveEditors(); MAX_ACTIVE_EDITORS/EDITOR_LIMIT_MSG in src/server/errors.ts. inbox (each calls requireAdmin itself): listPrayerRequests({q,page,status}), getPrayerRequest(id), listContactMessages({q,page,status,kind}), getContactMessage(id), countNewInbox(). audit: listAuditLogs({page,entityType?,actorId?}) (50/page, includes actor {id,name}), listAuditEntityTypes(). dashboard: getDashboardCounts() -> { publishedPosts, draftPosts, upcomingEvents, newPrayerRequests, newMessages }. List search params: parseListQuery(searchParams, { type?: PostType, status?: ContentStatus, ... }) in src/lib/validation/list-query.ts (PAGE_SIZE 20, AUDIT_PAGE_SIZE 50). Guards: src/server/auth/guards.ts getCurrentAdmin, requireAdmin, requireOwner, requireAdminPage(path), requireOwnerPage(path), AuthzError, AdminActor {id,email,name,role}.

TEST HELPERS: src/test/db-setup.ts now mocks @/auth (auth() returns setTestSession(user|null); signIn('admin-totp') runs the real authorizeAdminTotp and wraps non-AuthErrors as CallbackRouteError with cause.err; signOut spy) and resetDb also clears headers + session. src/test/factories.ts: makeOwner/makeEditor(overrides incl. password, totp:false) -> AdminUser & { password, totpSecret } (create with totpSecretEnc null, then update with seal(secret, totp:<id>)), TEST_PASSWORD, makeCategory, makePrayerRequest, makeContactMessage (+ existing makePost/makeEvent/makeMedia/makeVerse). src/test/forms.ts: form(fields), postForm(overrides). src/server/auth/login.ts exports clock ({now}) for vi.spyOn; generateTotp(secret, now?) in src/server/auth/totp.ts for E2E/tests (pure; Playwright helpers may import otplib directly instead).

E2E USERS: scripts/e2e-prepare.ts now creates owner@e2e.test 'E2E Owner' OWNER, editor@e2e.test 'E2E Editor' EDITOR, editor2@e2e.test 'E2E Editor 2' EDITOR (24-char passwords, TOTP enabled) and writes playwright/.auth/e2e-users.json as { owner|editor|editor2: { email, password, totpSecret, name, role } }.

DEVIATIONS / NOTES: (1) vitest.config.mts test.server.deps.inline: ['next-auth'] (next-auth imports 'next/server' without extension; Node ESM rejects it under Vitest). (2) MarkdownContent (src/components/ui/MarkdownContent.tsx, props markdown, className?, lang?) is NOT exported from src/components/ui/index.ts because it imports server-only markdown.ts and the index is used by client components; import it by path in server components. (3) Domain errors live in src/server/errors.ts (DomainError, EditorLimitError) and service types (Tx, ServiceResult, Page, paginate) in src/server/services/shared.ts. (4) Owner targets in user actions -> FORBIDDEN 'The owner account can't be changed here.' (5) completeLogin re-checks consumedAt after a wrong code so a parallel loser deterministically gets challenge_expired. (6) changePasswordAction applies the lock with bumpSessionVersion only at exactly count 5 (count >5 self-heal path locks without bump). (7) In PowerShell use npm.cmd (not npm) when piping stdin into 'npm run x -- args', otherwise the -- separator is lost. (8) Admin action FormData keys starting with '$' (Next internals) are dropped by formDataToObject.
